Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed in Pause > Controls screen; Esc opens pause menu with Continue/Controls/Settings/Save and Quit): WASD move, mouse primary/secondary click, Left Alt force inspect, Left Ctrl force attack, F attack, Space action, Q/E rotate, wheel zoom, Tab map, Esc pause, Open Crafting = Caps Lock (not usable via allowed keys), number keys select inventory slots. Pause menu buttons: Continue ~x0.315, Controls ~x0.43, Settings ~x0.55, Save&Quit ~x0.68 (all at y≈0.58); Controls screen Close at ~(0.21,0.78); right-arrow pages through bindings.

CRAFTING UI MECHANICS (verified): the left vertical column is the crafting bar; category icon centers sit at the very left edge around x≈0.028 (not x≈0.04 — earlier clicks there missed). Tools/axe icon ≈ y0.10-0.12, Light/flame ≈ y0.19-0.20, rope ≈ y0.25. Clicking a category opens a recipe plaque column at x≈0.10 with square plaques stacked ~0.10-0.11 apart vertically; actual plaque rows started near y≈0.31 in Light tab (upper region is decorative). Hovering a plaque shows a recipe card listing ingredient counts (have/need) and a Build button to the right of the panel (~x0.29-0.38, y≈0.66 when card open). Build is greyed if ingredients missing. Clicking Build crafts and closes the panel. Pressing C, Space, or Return alone never crafted; mouse hovering wrong rows showed nothing, so hover to identify each recipe. Light tab observed order: Campfire (y≈0.31, needs 3 grass + 2 logs), Fire Pit (y≈0.42, needs rocks), Torch (y≈0.52). Torch recipe = 2 grass + 2 twigs; crafting succeeded once, torch equipped in hand with durability % ticking down steadily (~2 minutes of life, decreasing roughly every few seconds).

RESOURCE MECHANICS: flowers click-pick into petal stack (slot 1). Grass tufts: pickable ones look bright yellow/green and show tooltip 'Pick Grass'; harvested ones are dull and show 'Examine Grass'. Saplings: pickable show 'Pick Sapling' (yield 1 twig); harvested become curved/bare tannish stumps labeled 'Examine Sapling' — these curved ground sprites are NOT loose twig pickups (learned by repeated false assumptions). Trees show 'Walk to Evergreen'/'Examine Evergreen' when clicked; trunks and the character's own sprite block plant clicks, so click precise sprite pixels and hover first to confirm label. Berry bushes with red dots and red ground mushrooms were seen but never harvested/eaten (effect unknown). Orange glowing clusters are fireflies: not interactive without a net. Map (Tab) showed only a small explored patch; rest black.

SURVIVAL LESSONS: Day 1 dusk brings message 'It's getting late. It will be dark soon.' Full darkness triggers 'What was that?!' warnings, then 'OW! Something hit me!' damage bursts; screen gains red vignette, health drops rapidly, and death results if no light. Torch is the key early goal: collect 2 twigs + 2 grass well before dusk, ideally gather extra (2 grass + 2 twigs per torch) for spares/refuel, because saplings are sparse and twigs were the bottleneck (ran out of torch with 3 grass but only 1 twig and no saplings in sight). Priorities learned: scout/harvest saplings and pickable tufts in daylight, keep track of unharvested (bright) plants while exploring, and craft light before dusk rather than during darkness.

FAILED STRATEGIES/UNCERTAINTY: clicking crafting icons too far right, assuming curved stumps were pickups, hunting twigs after nightfall (too late), and wandering while torch burned down searching for saplings instead of securing materials earlier. Unknown: berry/mushroom edibility, whether fireflies can be caught, exact full recipe list contents.
